_note: Manual screening annotations by Claude (PHASE A). problem/contribution/methods/findings paraphrase ONLY the verified abstract (source recorded in catalog); nothing here comes from full text. inclusion/relevance/uncertainty are Claude's analytical judgement (Bengali).

excluded.C12: KAT (ICST 2024): C09/C10/C11-এর একই LLM-for-REST-testing ধারা; Katalon-এর industrial tool, তুলনামূলক কম স্বতন্ত্র অবদান। PHASE B-তে প্রয়োজনে পুনর্বিবেচনা।
excluded.C17: Volkswagen industrial experience report (ICST 2025): ছোট experience paper; EvoMaster group-এর ৭টি paper ইতিমধ্যে আছে (concentration bias কমাতে বাদ)। তবে real-world challenge-এর উৎস হিসেবে PHASE D-তে gap-validation-এ উপযোগী।
excluded.C20: RESTTESTGEN (ICST 2020): foundational, কিন্তু surveys (C04) ও tool comparisons (C03, C05)-এ আবৃত; পরবর্তী extended version (STVR 2022, ICSME 2022) আছে।
excluded.C24: BenGQL (ASE 2025 tool/demo track): benchmark resource হিসেবে মূল্যবান কিন্তু গবেষণা অবদান সীমিত; dataset-তালিকায় উল্লেখ থাকবে।
excluded.C42: When and How to Make Breaking Changes (TOSEM 2021): ecosystem-norm/সামাজিক দিক; API engineering technique-এর বাইরে। Library evolution-এ C37/C40/C41 যথেষ্ট।
excluded.C54: Toolformer (NeurIPS 2023): landmark, কিন্তু 'API' এখানে calculator/search-এর মতো toy tool; API engineering প্রশ্নের সঙ্গে সংযোগ দুর্বল। C55/C56 বাস্তব API নিয়ে কাজ করে। Landmark হিসেবে excluded-list-এ রাখা হলো, পুনঃঅন্তর্ভুক্তিযোগ্য।

C01.problem: Automatically testing cloud services through their REST APIs requires generating valid stateful request sequences from the API specification.
C01.contribution: RESTler, described by the authors as the first stateful REST API fuzzer.
C01.methods: Infers producer–consumer dependencies among request types from the specification and uses dynamic response feedback to prune invalid sequences.
C01.findings: Abstract reports 28 bugs found in GitLab and several in Azure/Office365 services, confirmed and fixed by owners.
C01.inclusion: Stateful REST fuzzing-এর ভিত্তি; প্রায় সব পরবর্তী tool এর সঙ্গে তুলনা করে (baseline)।
C01.relevance: যেকোনো REST testing গবেষণার baseline ও ধারণাগত ভিত্তি।
C01.uncertainty: Full text paywalled (IEEE); OA PDF যাচাই হয়নি। arXiv-এ ভিন্ন শিরোনামে পূর্বসংস্করণ থাকতে পারে (যাচাই হয়নি)।

C02.problem: White-box, developer-side automated test generation for RESTful APIs, including creating prerequisite resources.
C02.contribution: Evolutionary white-box test generation with REST-aware smart sampling, implemented in the open-source EvoMaster tool.
C02.methods: Evolutionary algorithm rewarded by code coverage and fault-finding; sampling templates based on REST design conventions.
C02.findings: 80 real bugs found in five open-source services; coverage was lower than existing manual test suites (author-reported limitation).
C02.inclusion: White-box search-based REST testing-এর ভিত্তি; EvoMaster বহু পরবর্তী গবেষণার platform।
C02.relevance: White-box বনাম black-box তুলনা ও SQL/database handling-এর মতো open problem-এর উৎস।

C03.problem: REST API testing tools were evaluated on different benchmarks and metrics, making comparison difficult.
C03.contribution: Empirical comparison of 10 REST API testing tools on 20 real-world open-source services.
C03.methods: Systematic tool selection; measured code coverage and unique failures.
C03.findings: Identifies strengths, weaknesses and limitations of tools and strategies (details only in full text).
C03.inclusion: ক্ষেত্রের সবচেয়ে প্রভাবশালী tool-comparison; open problem-এর primary evidence।
C03.relevance: Gap analysis-এর জন্য author-documented limitation পাওয়ার সম্ভাবনা বেশি।
C03.uncertainty: নির্দিষ্ট ফলাফল abstract-এ নেই; full text (arXiv 2204.08348) পড়তে হবে।

C04.problem: Fragmented research on automated verification of RESTful APIs.
C04.contribution: Review of 92 scientific articles on RESTful API testing with categorisation and challenges.
C04.methods: Database search on seven databases, predefined criteria, snowballing.
C04.findings: Interest has grown since 2017; many open research challenges remain (author statement).
C04.inclusion: REST testing-এর সবচেয়ে উদ্ধৃত সাম্প্রতিক survey; backward-citation-এর উৎস।
C04.relevance: Taxonomy ও challenge-তালিকা cluster গঠনে কাজে লাগবে।
C04.uncertainty: Survey ২০২২ পর্যন্ত সাহিত্য কভার করে বলে ধারণা; LLM-যুগের কাজ অনুপস্থিত থাকতে পারে।

C05.problem: Black-box REST fuzzers are rarely analysed for what code they actually fail to cover.
C05.contribution: Comparison of seven fuzzers on 18 open-source, 1 industrial and 1 artificial API with source-level analysis of uncovered code.
C05.methods: Coverage measurement plus manual analysis of uncovered code regions.
C05.findings: Points to clear limitations of current fuzzers and lists concrete follow-up challenges (details in full text).
C05.inclusion: 'Open problems' সরাসরি তালিকাভুক্ত — Class A gap-এর সম্ভাব্য উৎস।
C05.relevance: LLM-based tool এই open problem সমাধান করেছে কিনা — যাচাইয়ের ভিত্তিরেখা।
C05.uncertainty: Authors EvoMaster group থেকে — নিজস্ব tool-এর পক্ষে bias সম্ভাব্য (hypothesis)।

C06.problem: Testing tools treat all operations/parameters equally and lack prioritisation; struggle without response schemas.
C06.contribution: ARAT-RL: adaptive REST API testing using reinforcement learning to prioritise operations and parameters.
C06.methods: RL-based prioritisation, dynamic request/response analysis, sampling-based feedback processing; ablation study.
C06.findings: Outperforms state-of-the-art tools on ten services in coverage, efficiency and fault finding (author claim).
C06.inclusion: RL-ভিত্তিক REST testing-এর প্রতিনিধি; পরবর্তী কাজের baseline।
C06.relevance: RL বনাম LLM পদ্ধতির তুলনামূলক বিশ্লেষণে প্রয়োজন।

C07.problem: Natural-language parts of OpenAPI specifications (examples, inter-parameter dependencies) are neglected by testing tools.
C07.contribution: NLPtoREST: extracts OpenAPI rules from human-readable descriptions and enhances the specification, with a validation step for spurious rules.
C07.methods: NLP rule extraction + validation; evaluated with eight testing tools.
C07.findings: Extracts many relevant rules with high accuracy and significantly improves tools' performance (author claim).
C07.inclusion: Specification enrichment ধারণার সূচনা; T1–T4 সংযোগকারী।
C07.relevance: Spec quality কীভাবে testing প্রভাবিত করে — তার প্রমাণ।

C08.problem: OAS lacks business-logic semantics such as implicit operation ordering and input constraints, limiting black-box testing.
C08.contribution: DeepREST: black-box REST testing using curiosity-driven deep reinforcement learning to uncover implicit constraints.
C08.methods: Deep RL agent learns operation order and input generation; alternates exploration with mutation-based exploitation.
C08.findings: High coverage and fault detection, superior to a state-of-the-art baseline (author claim; abstract via Consensus CO001).
C08.uncertainty: OpenAlex abstract কাটা; পূর্ণ abstract Consensus থেকে। একটিমাত্র baseline-এর সঙ্গে তুলনা (abstract অনুযায়ী)।

C09.problem: Existing rule-extraction techniques from specification text are limited and inaccurate.
C09.contribution: RESTGPT: uses LLMs to extract machine-interpretable rules and generate example values from OpenAPI descriptions.
C09.methods: LLM prompting over specifications; augments the spec.
C09.findings: Outperforms existing techniques in rule extraction and value generation (author claim).
C09.inclusion: REST testing-এ LLM প্রয়োগের প্রথম দিকের প্রভাবশালী কাজ; C10/C11-এর baseline।
C09.uncertainty: NIER (short paper) — মূল্যায়ন সীমিত হতে পারে।

C10.problem: LLM use in REST API testing is unexplored and large models are costly.
C10.contribution: LlamaRestTest: two fine-tuned, quantized Llama3-8B models for input generation and inter-parameter dependency discovery.
C10.methods: Fine-tuning on mined REST example values/dependencies; 2/4/8-bit quantization; ablation; compared with RESTGPT, RESTler, MoRest, EvoMaster, ARAT-RL on 12 services.
C10.findings: Fine-tuned small models outperform much larger ones for dependency rules and valid inputs; higher coverage and more 500 errors than compared tools (author claim).
C10.inclusion: Small LM-এ কার্যকারিতা — সীমিত infrastructure-এ গবেষণার সম্ভাব্যতা।
C10.relevance: Feasible research direction নির্ধারণে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ (কম compute)।
C10.uncertainty: ১২টি service; একই group-এর পূর্বের tool-এর সঙ্গে তুলনা।

C11.problem: Tools optimise test elements in isolation, lowering coverage and fault detection.
C11.contribution: AutoRestTest: multi-agent RL with a semantic property dependency graph and LLM value generation.
C11.methods: Four cooperating agents (API, dependency, parameter, value), SPDG, MARL; ablation; 12 services.
C11.findings: Outperforms four leading black-box tools including RESTGPT-assisted ones; only tool to trigger a 500 error in Spotify (author claim).
C11.inclusion: ICSE 2025 — REST testing-এ সাম্প্রতিক state-of-the-art দাবি।
C11.uncertainty: Evaluation-এর পরিসর ও reproducibility full text-এ যাচাই।

C13.problem: Test oracles of REST testing tools only detect crashes, regressions and spec violations.
C13.contribution: AGORA: generates test oracles by detecting likely invariants of API responses (extended Daikon; Beet instrumenter).
C13.methods: Dynamic invariant detection over request/response logs; up to 105 invariant types.
C13.findings: 81.2% precision on 11 operations from 7 industrial APIs; detected 6 of 10 seeded errors; revealed 11 bugs in popular APIs (author-reported).
C13.inclusion: Oracle problem — REST testing-এর মৌলিক দুর্বলতা।
C13.relevance: Business-logic/semantic oracle gap-এর জন্য সরাসরি প্রমাণ।
C13.uncertainty: TOSEM 2025-এ সম্ভবত extended version আছে (10.1145/3726524) — PHASE B-তে সম্পর্ক যাচাই।

C14.problem: No common, easy-to-run benchmark for comparing web-service fuzzers.
C14.contribution: EMB: curated corpus of web/enterprise applications (REST, GraphQL, RPC) with tooling for experiments.
C14.methods: Corpus curation and library support (databases, auth, start/stop scripts).
C14.findings: Describes design and use; maintained since 2017 (abstract).
C14.inclusion: Dataset availability — feasibility মূল্যায়নের মূল উপাদান।
C14.uncertainty: Corpus EvoMaster-এর জন্য তৈরি — selection bias সম্ভব।

C15.problem: OpenAPI cannot formally express inter-parameter dependencies.
C15.contribution: IDL (Inter-parameter Dependency Language), mapping to CSP, seven analysis operations, and a tool suite.
C15.findings: Enables automated analysis of IDL specifications (abstract; no quantitative result stated).
C15.inclusion: Inter-parameter dependency ধারণার formal ভিত্তি; পরবর্তী বহু LLM কাজ এটি লক্ষ্য করে।

C16.problem: Testing approaches use status codes but ignore error-message content when inferring input constraints.
C16.contribution: EmRest: black-box testing that statistically analyses 4xx error messages to infer constraints and 5xx messages to focus effort.
C16.methods: Combinatorial sampling of value-assignment strategies + statistical error-message analysis + mutation.
C16.findings: Higher operation coverage than SOTA in 50% of 16 APIs; 226 unique bugs undetected by others (author-reported).
C16.inclusion: Error message-কে feedback হিসেবে ব্যবহার — নতুন signal।
C16.relevance: LLM ছাড়াই কার্যকর পদ্ধতি — তুলনার জন্য গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।

C18.problem: Flakiness in system-level REST API tests is under-explored compared to unit tests.
C18.contribution: Empirical study of flakiness in EvoMaster-generated tests on 36 APIs; taxonomy of sources from ~3000 failing tests; FlakyCatch.
C18.findings: FlakyCatch effective for white-box and black-box fuzzers' tests (author claim).

C19.problem: Authentication handling, fault cataloguing and fair case-study selection hinder REST fuzzing research.
C19.contribution: WFC (libraries/schemas for auth & fault types) and WFD (36 APIs); comparison guidelines.
C19.methods: Experiments with EvoMaster vs ARAT-RL, EmRest, LlamaRestTest, RESTler, Schemathesis.
C19.findings: Discusses common pitfalls in tool comparisons (details in full text).

C21.problem: State of GraphQL research and knowledge gaps.
C21.findings: Adoption growing; need for more rigorous empirical evidence and studies on GraphQL components, especially consumption (author statement).
C21.inclusion: GraphQL ক্ষেত্রের একমাত্র উচ্চ-মানের mapping study।
C21.uncertainty: OpenAlex 2022 বনাম Crossref 2023 — online বছর পার্থক্য।

C22.contribution: Framework for white-box (evolutionary) and black-box (random) GraphQL testing in EvoMaster.
C22.methods: Schema extraction, evolutionary search vs random; 7 open-source + 31 online APIs.
C22.findings: Statistically significant improvement of evolutionary over random in white-box mode; black-box finds real faults (author-reported).

C23.problem: Clients can send overly expensive GraphQL queries; providers lack principled cost estimation.
C23.contribution: Linear-time, provably correct static GraphQL query cost analysis supporting common conventions.
C23.methods: Formal semantics; evaluated on a query-response corpus of two commercial APIs.
C23.findings: Consistently obtains tight upper bounds; existing static analyses over/under-estimate (author-reported).

C25.problem: No tool for automated testing of modern RPC-based APIs (gRPC, Thrift, Dubbo).
C25.contribution: First approach for white-box fuzzing of RPC APIs, schema specification + parser, integrated in EvoMaster and an industrial pipeline.
C25.methods: Search-based testing with RPC-specific heuristics; 2 artificial + 4 industrial services; 50 more industrial APIs.
C25.findings: 41 real faults identified and fixed; significant coverage improvement (author-reported).

C26.problem: Lack of empirical evidence on GraphQL vs REST implementation effort.
C26.contribution: Controlled experiment with 22 students implementing 8 queries.
C26.methods: Controlled experiment, effort measured in time.
C26.findings: GraphQL required less effort (median 6 vs 9 minutes); gains larger for complex endpoints (author-reported).
C26.inclusion: API architecture style তুলনায় একমাত্র rigorous experiment পাওয়া গেছে।
C26.uncertainty: ছোট নমুনা, শুধু ছাত্র — external validity সীমিত (analyst inference)।

C27.problem: Attackers can exploit vulnerabilities in REST APIs of cloud services.
C27.contribution: Four security rules for REST APIs and active property checkers in a stateful fuzzer.
C27.methods: Extension of stateful fuzzing (RESTler) with modular checkers.
C27.findings: New bugs found in production Azure/Office365 services, all fixed (author-reported).
C27.inclusion: REST API security testing-এর ভিত্তিমূলক কাজ।
C27.uncertainty: OA PDF যাচাই হয়নি; শুধু Microsoft services-এ মূল্যায়ন।

C28.problem: Mass assignment vulnerabilities in RESTful APIs.
C28.contribution: Black-box detection: clustering to find read-only fields, template-based attack sequences, specific oracle.
C28.methods: OpenAPI-driven test generation; evaluated on case studies in different languages.
C28.findings: Effective on seeded vulnerabilities with high accuracy (author claim).
C28.inclusion: OWASP API Top-10 দুর্বলতার স্বয়ংক্রিয় শনাক্তকরণ (ICSE)।
C28.relevance: Security testing-এ seeded বনাম বাস্তব vulnerability মূল্যায়ন প্রশ্ন।
C28.uncertainty: Seeded vulnerability-তে মূল্যায়ন — বাস্তব কার্যকারিতা অনিশ্চিত (analyst inference)।

C29.problem: Detecting broken object-level authorization (BOLA) attacks in REST APIs.
C29.contribution: Transformation from OpenAPI to Colored Petri Nets and a tool for BOLA attack detection from server logs.
C29.methods: Formal modelling + log/trace analysis; case study on a vulnerable web application.
C29.inclusion: BOLA = OWASP API #1; formal পদ্ধতির প্রতিনিধি।
C29.uncertainty: একটি case study; তুলনামূলক baseline নেই (abstract অনুযায়ী)।

C30.problem: REST fuzzers focus on crashes (5xx) and miss access-policy violations.
C30.contribution: Automated oracles for access-policy violations integrated in EvoMaster as a post-fuzzing security phase.
C30.methods: Oracle design; artificial examples + 13 real-world APIs.
C30.findings: Detected security issues in some APIs (author-reported).
C30.inclusion: Security oracle-কে fuzzer-এ সংযুক্ত করার সাম্প্রতিক কাজ।
C30.uncertainty: JSS 2026 extension আছে বলে মনে হয় (10.1016/j.jss.2026.113060) — সম্পর্ক যাচাই।

C31.problem: Security testing approaches for RESTful APIs (title only).
C31.inclusion: REST API security testing-এর সর্বশেষ survey (title অনুযায়ী) — সম্ভাব্য গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।
C31.uncertainty: শুধু metadata; abstract পাওয়া যায়নি; Crossref issue বছর 2027 (article-in-press)।

C32.problem: OpenAPI specifications are time-consuming to maintain and often incomplete or inconsistent.
C32.contribution: Respector: static and symbolic analysis generating REST API specifications from source code.
C32.methods: Static + symbolic program analysis; 15 real-world APIs; precision/recall.
C32.findings: Promising precision/recall; found missing endpoints/parameters/constraints and spec–implementation inconsistencies; outperforms annotation- and invocation-based techniques (author claim).
C32.uncertainty: OA PDF যাচাই হয়নি; Java-কেন্দ্রিক হতে পারে।

C33.problem: API testing tools need specifications which may be missing or inconsistent.
C33.contribution: Carving API tests and OpenAPI specs from UI test navigation, including endpoint inference via directed probing.
C33.methods: Dynamic analysis via UI navigation; 7 web applications.
C33.findings: 98% precision, 56% recall in endpoint inference; coverage gains when added to tool-generated suites (author-reported).
C33.relevance: Static (C32) বনাম dynamic বনাম LLM (C34, C35) তুলনা।

C34.problem: API information online is unstructured HTML documentation, not machine-readable specs needed by agents.
C34.contribution: Framework (OASBuilder per arXiv title) converting documentation pages into OpenAPI specs with LLMs + rule-based algorithms.
C34.methods: LLM + rule-based pipeline guided by documentation-page structure.
C34.findings: Generalises across hundreds of APIs; valid OpenAPI; deployed in an enterprise setting (author claim, from ACL Anthology abstract).
C34.inclusion: Spec generation ও LLM agent-এর সংযোগ সরাসরি।
C34.uncertainty: Industry track; quantitative বিবরণ abstract-এ নেই।

C35.problem: OAS generation approaches rely on technology-specific rules and experts; LLMs suffer context limits and hallucination.
C35.contribution: OOPS: technology-agnostic LLM-agent static analysis of server code for OAS generation.
C35.methods: API dependency graph for context; multi-stage generation and self-refine; 12 APIs, 5 languages, 8 frameworks.
C35.findings: Average F1 >98% endpoint methods, 97% params/responses, 92% constraints (author-reported).
C35.inclusion: LLM-ভিত্তিক spec inference-এর সাম্প্রতিক peer-reviewed কাজ।

C36.problem: Little concrete information on technical features of real REST APIs.
C36.contribution: Analysis of 500 public REST APIs from Alexa top-4000 sites.
C36.methods: Manual/automated feature analysis; REST principle compliance.
C36.findings: Only 0.8% strictly comply with all REST principles; high diversity (author-reported).

C37.problem: Scattered literature on API evolution challenges.
C37.contribution: SLR on APIs and API evolution: trends, goals, methods, metrics, challenges.
C37.findings: Main remaining challenges: factors driving API changes; uniform benchmarks; impact across languages (author-stated).
C37.inclusion: API evolution-এর সবচেয়ে প্রামাণিক SLR; Class A gap-এর উৎস।

C38.problem: Reasons behind microservice API evolution challenges are unknown.
C38.contribution: 17 interviews in 11 companies; six strategies, six challenges; two core problems (organizational coupling, consumer lock-in).
C38.findings: Proposes automating change-impact analysis and change communication as open research directions (author-stated).
C38.inclusion: Web/microservice API evolution-এ author-documented research direction।

C39.problem: Detecting breaking changes across REST API versions (spec and service).
C39.contribution: Differential regression testing for REST APIs using RESTler-generated inputs.
C39.methods: Differential testing across versions; handling non-determinism.
C39.findings: 14 regressions across 17 Azure networking API versions (5 spec, 9 service) (author-reported).
C39.inclusion: Web API breaking-change detection-এর প্রধান technique।

C40.problem: Behavioral (semantic) breaking changes in library updates are understudied.
C40.contribution: Large study: 30,548 dependencies; updates run against client test suites; taxonomy of effects.
C40.methods: Automated dependency updates + client test execution.
C40.findings: 2.30% of updates had behavioral BCs; most in non-major updates violating semver (author-reported).
C40.inclusion: Behavioral BC — syntactic BC-এর বাইরে নতুন দিক।
C40.relevance: Evolution cluster; LLM-যুগের সঙ্গে সংযোগ সম্ভব।

C41.problem: Prior study claimed BCs are widespread regardless of semver in Maven Central.
C41.contribution: External differentiated replication with Maracas tool; 119,879 upgrades, 293,817 clients.
C41.findings: 83.4% of upgrades comply with semver; only 7.9% clients affected — contrasts the original study (author-reported).
C41.uncertainty: Abstract arXiv version থেকে; journal version-এ সংখ্যা ভিন্ন হতে পারে।

C43.problem: Web API evolution should be driven by consumers' actual usage.
C43.contribution: Process-mining, pattern-based method to detect usage patterns implying API changes.
C43.methods: Usage-log analysis; two real-world WAPIs (FIB-UPC, DHIS2).
C43.inclusion: Usage-driven web API evolution — বিরল দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি।

C44.problem: RESTful API deprecation practices are unstudied (prior work: Java/Android).
C44.contribution: RADA analyzer and study of 2,224 OpenAPI specs of 1,368 APIs from APIs.guru.
C44.findings: Several severe deprecation-related problems in existing RESTful APIs (author-reported).
C44.inclusion: REST deprecation-এর প্রথম empirical study; APIs.guru dataset ব্যবহার।

C45.problem: No automatic detection of API documentation smells.
C45.contribution: Catalog of five smells, benchmark of 1,000 documentation units, practitioner survey (21), classifiers.
C45.methods: Manual labelling; rule-based, shallow and deep ML (BERT).
C45.findings: BERT F1 0.75–0.97; 95.2% developers report productivity harm (author-reported).
C45.inclusion: Documentation quality-র প্রধান কাজ; benchmark আছে।
C45.uncertainty: Java docs; web API docs-এ প্রযোজ্যতা অজানা।

C46.problem: Empirical evidence for RESTful API design rules is lacking.
C46.contribution: Controlled web experiment with 105 participants on 12 design rules.
C46.findings: Violations worse for 11 of 12 rules in comprehension (author-reported).
C46.inclusion: Design rule-এর প্রমাণভিত্তিক মূল্যায়ন — rigorous design।

C47.problem: Practitioners struggle to identify REST design rule violations.
C47.contribution: RESTRuler: static analysis of OpenAPI for 14 rules (some NLP-based).
C47.methods: Benchmark: 2,300+ public OpenAPI descriptions; 111 expert-constructed violations.
C47.relevance: Design quality; LLM দিয়ে recall বাড়ানোর সম্ভাবনা (hypothesis)।

C48.problem: Scaling API governance in a large organization.
C48.contribution: Google's AIPs, API Linter, API Readability program; mixed-methods evaluation.
C48.findings: Positive sentiment; newer API producers reported worse sentiment (author-reported).
C48.inclusion: API governance-এর একমাত্র শক্তিশালী industrial প্রমাণ।
C48.uncertainty: একটি কোম্পানি; OA PDF যাচাই হয়নি।

C49.problem: Capabilities/limitations of static API-misuse detectors are unknown.
C49.contribution: MUC classification, MUBenchPipe benchmark, comparative evaluation with author validation.
C49.findings: Extremely low precision and recall; frequency-based 'deviation = misuse' assumption is a root cause (author-reported).

C50.contribution: SLR of 69 articles: 6 API types, 30 misuses, detection techniques, 10 measures, 9 benchmarks.
C50.findings: Lack of coverage in several areas; need standardized evaluation (author-stated).

C51.problem: Manual/heuristic generation of API parameter security rules (APSRs) misses rules.
C51.contribution: GPTAid: LLM-generated APSRs validated by execution feedback and refined by code differential analysis.
C51.methods: LLM generation of rules and right/violation code, dynamic execution filtering; 200 APIs from 8 libraries.
C51.findings: Abstract truncated in OpenAlex; quantitative results Not verified.
C51.uncertainty: Abstract অসম্পূর্ণ; full text (NDSS OA) পড়তে হবে।

C52.problem: Trustworthiness of LLM-generated code using Java security APIs.
C52.contribution: 48 tasks × 5 security APIs; automated + manual misuse detection on ChatGPT code.
C52.findings: ~70% of instances contain misuse; 20 misuse types; ~half of tasks at 100% (author-reported).
C52.inclusion: LLM-generated code-এ API misuse-এর quantitative প্রমাণ।
C52.uncertainty: শুধু ChatGPT ও Java; model সংস্করণ পুরোনো।

C53.problem: API misuse in LLM-generated code (method selection and parameters).
C53.contribution: Large study (3,209 method-level, 3,492 parameter-level misuses), four misuse types, Dr.Fix repair.
C53.methods: Manual annotation; three LLMs (StarCoder-7B, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, Copilot); Python & Java.
C53.findings: Persistent hallucination and intent misalignment; Dr.Fix gains up to 38.4 BLEU, 40% exact match (author-reported).
C53.uncertainty: BLEU repair-এর জন্য দুর্বল metric হতে পারে (analyst inference)।

C55.problem: LLMs hallucinate API calls and generate wrong arguments.
C55.contribution: Gorilla (fine-tuned LLaMA) with retriever; APIBench (HuggingFace, TorchHub, TensorHub).
C55.findings: Surpasses GPT-4 on writing API calls; adapts to doc changes; reduces hallucination (author claim).

C56.problem: Open-source LLMs are weak at using real-world APIs.
C56.contribution: ToolBench (16,464 RapidAPI REST APIs), DFSDT reasoning, ToolEval, ToolLLaMA, API retriever.
C56.findings: ToolLLaMA comparable to ChatGPT; generalises to unseen APIs (author claim).
C56.inclusion: বাস্তব REST API-ভিত্তিক tool-use dataset-এর landmark (ICLR 2024)।
C56.uncertainty: OpenAlex-এ arXiv DOI ভুল শিরোনামে map করা — DataCite/ICLR থেকে যাচাই করা হয়েছে।

C57.problem: How effective are LLMs at using tools and what obstacles remain.
C57.contribution: API-Bank: runnable system with 73 tools, 314 dialogues/753 calls; training set 1,888 dialogues; Lynx model.
C57.findings: GPT-4 excels in planning; Lynx +26 pts over Alpaca (author-reported).

C58.problem: Tool-learning benchmarks are unstable because real API status changes.
C58.contribution: StableToolBench: virtual API server (cache + simulators) and stable evaluation.
C58.inclusion: API instability/evolution-কে benchmark সমস্যা হিসেবে নথিভুক্ত করে।

C59.problem: Connecting LLMs to real-world RESTful APIs for complex instructions.
C59.contribution: RestGPT (coarse-to-fine planning, API executor) and RestBench.
C59.methods: LLM planning; two real-world scenarios with gold paths.
C59.inclusion: REST API-কে সরাসরি agent-এর লক্ষ্য হিসেবে ধরা।

C60.problem: Code LLMs hallucinate APIs, especially low-frequency ones.
C60.contribution: CloudAPIBench; analysis by API frequency; selective Documentation Augmented Generation.
C60.methods: Benchmark + retrieval triggering via API index or model confidence.
C60.findings: GPT-4o 38.58% valid low-frequency invocations; DAG helps low-frequency but hurts high-frequency with weak retrievers; +8.20% absolute with selective DAG (author-reported).
C60.inclusion: API hallucination ও documentation-এর সম্পর্ক — industrial (ICSE-SEIP)।

C61.contribution: Survey organised by planning, selection, calling, response generation; benchmarks summary.
C61.findings: Discusses challenges and future directions (author statement).

C62.problem: Architecture and security of the Model Context Protocol.
C62.contribution: MCP server lifecycle (4 phases, 16 activities), threat taxonomy (4 attacker types, 16 scenarios), case studies, safeguards.
C62.findings: Proposes safeguards and research directions (author statement).

C63.problem: Health, security and maintainability of MCP servers.
C63.contribution: Large study of 1,899 open-source MCP servers with hybrid static analysis.
C63.methods: Health metrics, general static analyser + MCP-specific scanner.
C63.findings: 8 vulnerability types (3 overlap traditional); 7.2% general vulns, 5.5% tool poisoning; 66% code smells (author-reported).

C64.problem: Relationship between MCP tool interfaces and underlying REST APIs is uncharacterised.
C64.contribution: Study of 116 official MCP servers; OpenAPI pairing; AutoMCP generation pipeline with spec repair.
C64.methods: Four RQs; generation from 80 OpenAPI contracts.
C64.findings: 88.6% REST-backed; 92% bare wrappers; median 19% of operations exposed; generation 76% → 94.2% after repair (author-reported, v4).
C64.inclusion: REST ↔ agent সেতুবন্ধন — T4 ও T8 সরাসরি যুক্ত।
C64.relevance: Spec quality → agent tool success-এর প্রমাণ।
C64.uncertainty: Preprint; arXiv version-এর মধ্যে শিরোনাম ও সংখ্যা পরিবর্তিত হয়েছে (v1 বনাম v4)।

C65.contribution: SLR of 74 primary studies classified by SWEBOK testing taxonomy (from partial abstract).
C65.findings: Dominated by early-stage proposals; need empirical validation and industry-grade benchmarks (partial abstract via web search).

C66.problem: Service-level tests for enterprise Java apps without OpenAPI specs, beyond fuzzing.
C66.contribution: SAINT: static analysis + LLM agents for endpoint and scenario-based tests.
C66.methods: Endpoint model, operation dependency graph, agentic plan/act/reflect; 8 Java apps incl. proprietary; developer survey.
C66.findings: Effective coverage, fault detection and scenario generation (author claim).

C67.problem: Detecting anomalous API traffic in microservice architectures.
C67.inclusion: API monitoring ক্ষেত্রের প্রতিনিধি — উচ্চ-মানের বিকল্প পাওয়া যায়নি।

C68.problem: Lack of uniform task definition and benchmark for API recommendation.
C68.contribution: Benchmark (named APIBench) for query-based and code-based API recommendation; study of 11 approaches + 4 IDEs.
C68.findings: Insights on query reformulation, data sources, low-resource, user-defined APIs (author statement).
C68.relevance: Recommendation → LLM tool retrieval-এর স্থানান্তর বোঝা।
C68.uncertainty: নাম-সংঘাত: Gorilla-র APIBench (C55) থেকে আলাদা। Online 2022, issue 2023।

C69.problem: LLM-based code completion may use deprecated APIs due to library evolution.
C69.contribution: First evaluation of deprecated API usage: 7 LLMs, 145 API mappings, 8 Python libraries, 28,125 prompts; ReplaceAPI and InsertPrompt baselines.
C69.methods: Empirical evaluation by model, prompt, library; lightweight fixes.
C69.findings: Reveals status quo and root causes (details in full text) (author statement).

C70.problem: Tools/APIs change over time; LLMs trained on static environments fail.
C70.contribution: ToolEVO (MCTS-based exploration, self-reflection, self-updating tool usage) and ToolQA-D benchmark.
C70.methods: Monte Carlo Tree Search in dynamic environments.
C70.findings: Effective and stable under tool variability (author claim).
C70.inclusion: API evolution × agent tool use — সরাসরি সংযোগ (ICLR 2025)।
C70.uncertainty: ToolQA-D synthetic variability কিনা — যাচাই দরকার।
